extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent practitioners, USPTO fee payers, and USPTO program managers
extracted.subtask_description: Extract and apply the USPTO FY24/FY25 patent- and PCT-related fee schedule items, related surcharges, and reporting/implementation tracking categories (e.g., maintenance fees, filing fees, trial & appeal fees, PCT fees). Useful for determining required payments and compliance with USPTO procedural reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application filing fee types
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists the basic filing fee types for patent applications (provisional, basic filing fee - utility, basic filing fee - design, basic filing fee - plant, basic filing fee - reissue, basic filing fee - design (CPA), basic filing fee - reissue (CPA)) and shows planned/actual collections by entity size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amounts differ by entity size (large/small/micro). Example values shown in Appendix II (e.g., provisional application filing fee listed as $300 for a large entity in the FY24 planned column). Use entity-size columns to select the correct amount when preparing payments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Surcharges (late filing, non‑DOCX, non‑English, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Surcharge items include late filing surcharge (late filing fee, late search/exam fee, late oath/declaration, filing without at least one claim or by reference), surcharge for late provisional filing or cover sheet, non-English translation fee, and non-DOCX filing surcharge fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the appropriate surcharge when the listed conditions occur (e.g., late filings or non‑DOCX submissions). Amounts and conditions are shown in the fee tables and vary by entity size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application size fees (per additional 50 sheets)
rubrics_metrics.description: Size fees apply for utility/design/reissue/provisional applications for each additional 50 sheets that exceed 100 sheets; also a National Stage Application Size Fee for PCT national stage filings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculate by counting sheets beyond the first 100 and applying the per-50-sheet fee (rounded per the fee table). Different fee codes and amounts apply by application type and entity size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence listing submission fees (by file size ranges)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees for submission of sequence listings: separate fee bands for 300MB–800MB and for more than 800MB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess the sequence file size and apply the appropriate fee code. Late furnishing of sequence listings under PCT Rule 13ter has a separate late furnishing fee in PCT fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search fees (utility, design, plant, reissue)
rubrics_metrics.description: Search fee categories include Utility Search Fee, Design Search Fee, Plant Search Fee, and Reissue Search Fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the search fee corresponding to the application type. Fees differ by entity size and are shown in the tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination fees (utility, design, plant, reissue)
rubrics_metrics.description: Examination fees for Utility Examination Fee, Design Examination Fee, Plant Examination Fee, and Reissue Examination Fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required to initiate examination; amounts and entity-size variants are provided in the appendix and must be paid as listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims-related fees (independent claims >3, claims >20, multiple dependent claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees apply for independent claims in excess of three, claims in excess of 20, multiple dependent claim fees, and parallel reissue-claim excess fees (reissue independent claims in excess of three; reissue claims in excess of 20).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Count claims and apply the excess-claim fees when thresholds are exceeded. Multiple dependent claim surcharges apply where applicable. Reissue-specific claim excess rules mirror the application claim excess rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for continued examination (RCE) fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees for RCE filings: 1st request RCE fee and 2nd and subsequent RCE request fees (see 37 CFR 1.114).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different fee amounts apply for the first RCE and later RCE filings; consult the fee table and pay the correct code for the sequence of RCEs in the prosecution history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for prioritized examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee for requesting prioritized examination (track I or similar) is listed as a separate fee code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A distinct higher fee applies to obtain prioritized examination. Entity-size variations apply as shown in the fee tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent post-allowance / issue fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Post-allowance fees include Utility Issue fee, Design Issue fee, Plant Issue fee, Publication fee for republication, Suspense Account for Partial Issue Payments, Issue Fee owed over current fee, Hague Design Issue Fee, and Reissue Issue fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issue fees become due on allowance/issuance; specific post-allowance items (e.g., republication, partial payments) have separate fee treatments. Use the correct fee code for the issue type and entity size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent maintenance fees and schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintenance fee schedule: fees due at 3.5 years, 7.5 years, and 11.5 years (with entity-size variants). Also lists surcharges for late payment within six months for each maintenance window, petition for delayed payment of maintenance fee, and patent unassigned maintenance fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must pay the maintenance fee at the stated anniversary windows to maintain enforceability. If paying after the due date but within the six‑month grace period, add the appropriate surcharge; for payments after that, file and pay a petition where permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent extension-of-time fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees for requesting extensions of time to respond (extension for response within first month, second month, third, fourth, fifth month) with totals grouped by entity size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a deadline extension is taken, apply the fee for the specific month of extension (1–5). Totals for extension fees are shown for each entity size; calculate based on how many months of extension are sought.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent trial and appeal fees (PTAB and appeals)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees in this category include Notice of Appeal, Request for oral hearing, filing a brief in support of an appeal in inter partes reexamination, petitions under 37 CFR 41.3, Inter Partes Review (IPR) request fee (up to 20 claims), IPR per-claim fees in excess of 20, Post‑Grant Review (PGR) request fees, post-institution fees (IPR/PGR) up to 20 claims and per-claim excess; petitions for derivation, forwarding appeals to the Board, Pro Hac Vice admission fee, and other PTAB-related fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different fees apply depending on the proceeding (IPR, PGR, covered business method review, appeal). There are distinct initial-institution fees (up to 20 claims) and per-claim fees for claims in excess of 20; post‑institution fees are separate. Consult the fee table to determine the correct fee code for the specific PTAB filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-issuance and reexamination fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees for post-issuance services: Certificate of Correction, Ex Parte Reexamination (non-streamlined and streamlined), statutory disclaimer (including terminal disclaimer), processing fee for correcting inventorship, refused reexamination request fees, request for supplemental examination, fees for reexamination ordered as a result of supplemental examination, and supplemental-examination document size fees (for non‑patent documents 21–50 sheets and per additional 50 sheets).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the appropriate post-issuance fee code for the action requested. Streamlined vs non-streamlined reexamination has distinct fees. Size fees apply when supplemental documents exceed listed sheet counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exhibit/Implementation tracking for GAO/OIG recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: Framework for reporting implementation of GAO public recommendations (designated as 'Open' or 'Closed‑Unimplemented') and OIG public recommendations for which Final Action has not been taken or Action Not Recommended has been taken. Tracks Action(s) Planned, Action Status (Planned, In‑Progress, or Complete), Target Completion Date, and Recommendation Status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each recommendation, document planned actions, status, target completion date, and whether closure is requested/pending. The report distinguishes recommendations the Department plans to implement vs those it decided not to implement (or that are 'Closed‑Unimplemented').

rubrics_metrics.name: OIG recommendation example: Active Directory / PIV compatibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific OIG recommendation (OIG-19-014-A) to ensure PIV card technology compatibility with ongoing and future system development for USPTO next-generation applications; lists systems to be integrated (e.g., COOP-WB, DAV, DOSS, ENS, ESP-*, PALM-*, etc.) and the plan to move older products to Okta authentication by end of FY2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target date changes and acknowledgements are tracked (example: target date change to 9/30/25 requested and acknowledged). Use the action-tracking template fields (Action(s) Planned, Status, Target Completion Date, Closure Request Pending) when responding to OIG recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting categories for recommendation status (Open, Closed‑Unimplemented)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections designate recommendations as 'Open', 'Closed-Unimplemented for past 5 years', or 'Closed' and require statements 'Nothing to Report' where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing semiannual or annual reports, populate the appropriate section depending on the recommendation designation; if none apply, explicitly state 'Nothing to Report.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Tribal consultations reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: A summary description field for Tribal Consultations and Tribal Input in the USPTO budget/report appendices. Example language: 'The United States Patent and Trademark Office does not have any tribal consultations to report. Summary Description of Tribal Input: None applicable.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If consultations occurred, provide a summary and monetary details where applicable; otherwise, include the explicit 'none to report' language.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT fees — national stage categories
rubrics_metrics.description: PCT national stage fee categories: independent claims in excess of three, claims in excess of 20, multiple dependent claim fee, search/exam fee or oath/declaration after commencement of national stage, English translation after 30 months from priority date, Basic National Stage Fee, National Stage Search Fee (all other situations; U.S. was ISA; search report provided to USPTO), National Stage Examination Fee (all other situations; U.S. was ISA), and National Stage Application Size Fee per additional 50 sheets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For national stage entries, apply the fees corresponding to the national stage treatment (e.g., whether the U.S. was ISA or not, whether a search report was provided). Entity-size variations exist. Use the national stage fee codes to compute total cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT fees — international stage categories
rubrics_metrics.description: PCT international stage fee categories: Transmittal fee, Search fee (regardless of corresponding application), Supplemental search fee when required per additional invention, Preliminary examination fee (U.S. was ISA vs U.S. not ISA), Supplemental examination fee per additional invention, Late payment fee, Transmitting application to International Bureau to act as receiving office, Suspense account for PCT payments, Late furnishing fee for sequence listing under PCT Rule 13ter, Petition for extension of the twelve-month (six-month for designs) period for filing a subsequent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply international-stage fees when filing PCT international-phase paperwork. Several fees depend on whether the U.S. was the ISA and whether supplemental searches or additional-invention handling apply. Late furnishing and late payment fees are separate charges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entity-size differentiation (Large / Small / Micro)
rubrics_metrics.description: Nearly all fee categories are reported with different amounts or totals for Large, Small, and Micro entities (tables show FY24PB Planned Fee Collections and Appendix II Actual Fee Collections broken out by entity size).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determine applicant entity status (large, small, micro) prior to fee calculation; apply the correct fee schedule column. The appendix includes both planned and actual collection columns to reference authoritative amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee table reporting format and cross-references
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees are listed by Fee Code and Fee Title with planned and actual fee collection columns and aggregated totals (e.g., Total Patent Filing Fees, Total Patent Post Allowance Fees, Total Patent Maintenance Fees).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When extracting fees, use Fee Code to map to the corresponding payment action in USPTO payment systems. Cross-reference aggregated totals for budgeting or forecasting purposes.
